name: Osei Threadmark Beaded Data Necklace
description:
Thirty-seven hand-knotted beads of varying diameter — volcanic glass, compressed bone resin, and a few unmistakable matte-black data capsules — strung on braided stainless micro-cable. The beads alternate matte and semi-gloss in no apparent pattern, but the data capsules (four of them, positioned at irregular intervals) are indistinguishable from the decorative glass unless you know what to feel for.

Each capsule is a standard 2mm micro-port data chip encased in polished resin, readable by any compatible neck-port or handheld reader. Worn as a statement piece that is also a filing system.
functionality: Four embedded 8TB data capsules readable via standard micro-port or handheld scanner. Stainless cable is rated for 40kg tensile before clasp release. Clasp is a manual friction lock, not magnetic — harder to accidentally trigger.
what_it_says: This person keeps what matters close to the body, hidden in plain sight, and has a cultural inheritance that doesn't separate beauty from function.
story_hooks: The studio's founder disappeared eight months ago; the current line is being run by someone who refuses to confirm or deny being the same person.
A data capsule from one of these necklaces surfaced in a Tier 5 evidence file — the contents haven't been disclosed.
Customs scanners at Spire-adjacent transit hubs have been reprogrammed to flag the specific resin signature of these capsules.
